args.title: Freight Pricing Q1 2026 — Combined Summary (Bellwether blog + companion)
args.body:
- Spot rates fell 9% this quarter, while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices (rather than a fixed lag).
- Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.

Sources: https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/freight and https://insights.bellwether.example/freight/companion
